observations.observed: An existing Tech is dismantled near a trading station, leaving a cab/blocks; the inventory then opens and another chassis is built in the same campaign world.
observations.selection: Context only; do not call this the game's initial creation tutorial or a new-world start.

observations.role: A chosen part changes the actual vehicle, rather than merely a settings number.
observations.before: A block chassis is suspended for editing; connection markers are visible and its near side has no wheel at the target position.
observations.action: GSO Dirt Wheel is selected and held next to the chassis at63.5s; it is attached by65.5s. Additional wheels and a GSO Rock Drill are selected/attached.
observations.result: A solid wheel is visible on the chassis at65.5s; the complete four-wheeled base and solid front GSO Rock Drill are visible at71.5s.
observations.limits: The source camera orbits while editing. The orbit alone is not proof of vehicle driving, new speed, or performance improvement.

observations.before: The same chassis has top guns and front drill; inventory and attachment markers remain visible.
observations.action: A GSO Riser Wheel is held against a side connection; additional top-part selection follows. Inventory closes around158s; a wheel is detached/adjusted around159–159.5s.
observations.result: The vehicle is on the ground in the world by162s with the edited block body, wheels, drill and top parts retained.
observations.limits: The wheel detachment must not be hidden by a narration claim that menu close instantly completed an optimal build. Do not call held green previews already installed.

observations.role: Actual movement after construction in the same world.
observations.before: Inventory is closed; vehicle is next to the trading station/nearby repair unit. At162s the minimap coordinates read-1031,-979.
observations.action: The vehicle changes position relative to fixed station, rock and repair unit, leaving fresh wheel tracks; the camera also follows/rotates.
observations.result: At164.5s the vehicle has moved beside the repair unit and the minimap reads-1027,-979; its edited body, drill and top parts remain visible.
observations.limits: Coordinates and landscape establish translation independently of the camera rotation. Do not convert this into a measured speed gain or claim a controlled before/after test.

observations.role: Return to editing without leaving the ongoing world.
observations.before: Inventory reopens at167s; the just-driven vehicle remains in the same place/world beside the repair unit.
observations.action: The vehicle is raised for editing, GSO One Block is selected, connection markers and a green held preview appear. At171.5s the central green part is still a preview, not a completed solid attachment.
observations.result: Raised solid blocks and repositioned guns on top are retained at175.5s after the inventory closes; the edited design is visible in the world.
observations.limits: No loading screen or separate editor level appears across this bounded sequence. Do not claim a timed usability comparison or that the new layout is better.

recommendedCuts.purpose: Visible wheel selection/attachment followed by drill attachment.
recommendedCuts.mustShow: Held part before attachment, solid wheel after, then the visibly changed vehicle; explain connection markers before using them as evidence.

recommendedCuts.purpose: Continuous in-world editing, a short drive, then immediate return to editing with another visible body change.
recommendedCuts.mustShow: Editing150–157.5, ground/adjustment158–161.5, actual translation162–166.5, inventory reopen167, block preview171.5 and solid retained edit175.5.
recommendedCuts.limits: Narration must acknowledge only the workflow, not improved handling, damage, or optimal assembly. Keep adjustments understandable; trim unnecessary selection only if the resulting state continuity remains honest.

recommendedCuts.purpose: Compact actual movement→return to parts editing→visible raised-body result, when attachment has already been established in the preceding cut.

visualEvidence.clearance: Keep left inventory name/count and vehicle wheel visible. Full source needs a root-owned layout check against fixed bottom captions.

visualEvidence.purpose: PPT evidence: vehicle on ground with retained configuration and fresh tracks; pair with162s only if explaining the observed movement.
visualEvidence.clearance: Protect vehicle outline, tracks, minimap and credit. Do not turn the source coordinates into a fabricated speed measurement.

visualEvidence.purpose: PPT evidence: raised solid block row and relocated guns after returning to edit.
visualEvidence.clearance: Label only the changed upper block row and guns; retain vehicle context instead of covering the change with a solid shape.
